sources.title: (26.19) Rock Solid: a Malphite Jungle Guide

passive.name: Granite Shield
passive.text: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.

spells.name: Seismic Shard
spells.text: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Thunderclap
spells.text: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.

spells.name: Ground Slam
spells.text: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.

spells.name: Unstoppable Force
spells.text: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.

damage.value: Malphite deals magic damage with Q and E and physical damage with W’s empowered attacks, giving him both short bursts and repeated attack damage.

archetype.value: Malphite is an armor-building tank who uses a shield and defensive items to stay in fights.

axis.value: Malphite can poke with Q’s damage and slow before committing to a closer trade.

winCondition.value: Malphite can solo carry games from the jungle.

spikes.at: Malphite gets more armor while Granite Shield is active
spikes.why: Malphite’s W armor bonus is tripled during that time.
Malphite can launch to a location, damage enemies, and knock them into the air.

bait.why: Malphite’s shield refreshes only after he avoids damage for a few seconds, so breaking it leaves a window before it returns.
Malphite cannot use Unstoppable Force again while its 130/115/100-second cooldown runs.
Malphite cannot apply Ground Slam’s Attack Speed reduction again until its 7-second cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Malphite loses Granite Shield’s recharge opportunity when he keeps getting hit.
